title: Python: step 5, the rich 3a109ccd labelled measurement of (a23) item 7
description: Filed record-only under opum-doc's ruling ODOC-640 (opum-ai/opum-doc#2065). Step 5 of the DEC-303 build order: label rich 3a109ccd (at least 62 attributable sites, call sites in seeded order) by the same census method as test/python-dev-measurement, the (a23) item 7 measurement. It is development data: reported to opum-doc and read before the freeze. Runs after NB-b. No measurement has been taken; this task files the item only.

acceptanceCriteria.text: At least 62 attributable sites in seeded order, labelled by the test/python-dev-measurement census method, independent of glyph
The result reported to opum-doc and read before the freeze; what was not measured is stated

plan: 1. Clone rich 3a109ccdffe5b2d0e30684a304fbd388e99ce57b outside the repo; run test/python-dev-measurement/census.py over package rich in seeded order (seed gcli142-dev-rich-1).
2. Hand-label every enumerated site by the census categories (D, N, C, S, K, Q2, ALIAS, TS; X excluded) in target order until at least 62 attributable sites are accumulated.
3. Score the labels against the dev analyzer at dce9e90 with score-dev.ts and record the bins and per-category counts.

4. Prepare enum-rich.json, labels-rich.json and a README row in the existing test/python-dev-measurement shape; report the labelled result to the leader for opum-doc; push nothing without the leader’s clear.
implementationNotes: Measurement taken 2026-11-27T15:40Z. Method: unmodified test/python-dev-measurement/census.py over Textualize/rich at 3a109ccdffe5b2d0e30684a304fbd388e99ce57b (verified by rev-parse), package rich, seed gcli142-dev-rich-1, max-targets 200 -> 200 targets, 807 candidate sites enumerated. Labelled the first 36 targets by hand against the census categories; call-form sites only, matching tqdm/flask (every label in labels-tqdm.json is call-form). Result: 66 attributable call sites (D 39, N 2, C 4, S 7, K 12, Q2 1, ALIAS 1; X 1). Scored with score-dev.ts against dev dce9e90 = 60/66 = 0.9091: D 39/39, N 1/2, C 4/4, S 7/7, K 9/12, Q2 0/1, ALIAS 0/1. Misses: 5.1 Console.render_str through a local bound to the bound method (ALIAS), 5.5 Console.render_str on self.console (Q2), 5.7 and 5.8 Console.render_str on an annotated console local (K), 6.0 Text.highlight_words on a Text local (K), 22.0 RichFormatter() for a class defined inside a function (N). Analyzer bins over the whole clone: 212 files, 9844 call expressions, resolvedInRepo 5613, resolvedExternal 2512, receiverNeedsInference 1409, nameNotBound 310. Not measured: 164 of the 200 enumerated targets; reference-form occurrences (annotations, imports, except clauses, bare bindings), excluded by the call-site convention of the prior samples; one labeller. Committed enum-rich.json, labels-rich.json and the README row and limits; no src change.

MISS CLASSIFICATION (item 3 of DEC-303 (a92); measured on dev dce9e90 with the analyzer at that commit, plus isolation probes of each shape; records only, no src change, 2026-11-27T15:50Z).

1. 5.1 rich/columns.py:67 render_str(renderable), a local bound to console.render_str (a Console instance's bound method). (a) UNRESOLVED: no edge and no call-site record. (b) ALIAS. (a23) item 2 covers a local with exactly one binding to Cls.attr or mod.attr; this binding is an instance attribute, not Cls.attr/mod.attr. Measured in isolation: rs = Console.render_str then rs("x") resolves to Console.render_str; rs = console.render_str then rs("x") emits nothing. (c) NOT as written; it is the ALIAS-adjacent gap already tracked as GCLI-114. Becomes a hold task only if ALIAS is ruled to cover instance-bound methods; otherwise a stated limit.

2. 5.5 rich/live.py:238 self.console.render_str. (a) UNRESOLVED. (b) Q2 (self.attr.m()), explicitly OUT of the build order; (a2) 3 rules it unresolved. (c) NOT covered by design; deferred category, stated limit for the pre-registration.

3. 5.7 rich/rule.py:66 console.render_str, console: Console. (a) UNRESOLVED. (b) (a2) ruling 3 known-class binding, the annotation arm; Q1 is not needed for this plain annotation. (c) YES, meant to cover. ROOT CAUSE MEASURED: a duplicate binding of the class NAME in the module. rule.py imports Console twice, line 3 from .console and line 118 from rich.console in its __main__ demo. In isolation the single-import shape resolves; ANY second import of Console (same path, other path, other scope, TYPE_CHECKING or inside if __name__ == "__main__") makes the annotated-receiver call emit no edge. On rich, a fresh probe module with the shape resolves; rule.py copied verbatim does NOT resolve line 66, and the same copy with its __main__ block removed DOES resolve to Console.render_str. A miss a landed rule was meant to cover: hold task, two rounds, intended delta only.

4. 5.8 rich/table.py:491 console.render_str inside the render_annotation closure, console: "Console". (a) UNRESOLVED. (b) the same annotation rule plus Q1 for the quoted form; table.py imports Console at 18-25 (TYPE_CHECKING, relative) and at 929 (absolute). (c) YES, meant to cover. SAME ROOT CAUSE as item 3, not the closure: the closure shape with a single import resolves, and a second import of Console removes the edge. Fold into the item 3 hold task; its fixtures should include a closure read.

5. 6.0 rich/logging.py:211 message_text.highlight_words. (a) UNRESOLVED. (b) R4 does not apply: the bindings are Text.from_markup(message), Text(message) and highlighter(message_text), not every binding Cls(...) of one class; (a2) 3's single-binding arm also fails. Covering it needs the callee's return annotation, i.e. Q3. (c) NOT covered; Q3 is OUT; deferred category, stated limit.

6. 22.0 rich/pretty.py:233 RichFormatter(), a class defined inside install.display_hook. (a) RESOLVED, to the CORRECT declaration: the edge targets rich/pretty.py:214 install.RichFormatter, the class's own symbol at the census target's def line. NOT a wrong-target resolution. It scores as a miss only because score-dev.ts keys symbols by (file, qualname): the census names the class install.display_hook.RichFormatter, the analyzer install.RichFormatter. (b) No rule gap; a scoring-key/qualname-shape disagreement between the census's textual nesting and the analyzer's qualname construction. (c) N/A. Consequence: by declaration the measurement is 61/66 = 0.9242, not 60/66.

OUTCOME for opum-doc: no wrong-target resolution among the six. One hold candidate covering items 3 and 4 (duplicate class-name import blocking annotation known-class binding); two deferred limits (item 2 Q2; item 5 Q3); item 1 a hold task only if ALIAS is widened to instance-bound methods, else a stated limit; item 6 is not a miss and the declared score corrects to 61/66.
